tokens.name: violet-50
tokens.usage: Lightest logo tint (logo violet mixed with logo white). Hover wash on light.

tokens.name: violet-100
tokens.usage: Lilac mist. Tinted bands, brand-soft fills, photo backdrop.

tokens.name: violet-200
tokens.usage: Selected and pressed fills on light.

tokens.name: violet-300
tokens.usage: Close to the logo's own edge tint (#BCB8E2). Brand text, focus and the pulse line on dark sections (6.1:1 on violet-900).

tokens.name: violet-400
tokens.usage: Close to the logo's mid tint (#9990D1). Decorative fills, illustration strokes on light.

tokens.name: violet-500
tokens.usage: Focus ring on light (4.1:1 on logo-white). Not for small text.

tokens.name: violet-600
tokens.usage: HEAL Violet, the logo field. Primary buttons, links, the brand section background (white text 5.9:1).

tokens.name: violet-700
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed for violet-600; brand-coloured text on violet-100 (6:1).

tokens.name: violet-800
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces inside dark sections.

tokens.name: violet-900
tokens.usage: Cards and bands inside dark sections.

tokens.name: violet-950
tokens.usage: Deep violet ink: headlines on light (16.5:1 on white) and the base of dark sections.

tokens.name: graphite-0
tokens.usage: Pure white canvas.

tokens.name: graphite-25
tokens.usage: Off-white for long reading pages.

tokens.name: graphite-50
tokens.usage: Neutral surface for alternating sections and cards.

tokens.name: graphite-100
tokens.usage: Input fills, subtle dividers on surface.

tokens.name: graphite-200
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and table rules on light.

tokens.name: graphite-300
tokens.usage: Strong hairline, decorative only (1.9:1).

tokens.name: graphite-400
tokens.usage: Placeholder text at 16px+ only; icons that are decorative.

tokens.name: graphite-500
tokens.usage: Muted text: captions, meta, eyebrows (5.1:1 on logo-white, 4.8:1 on violet-100).

tokens.name: graphite-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white.

tokens.name: graphite-700
tokens.usage: Body copy on light (9.6:1 on graphite-50).

tokens.name: graphite-800
tokens.usage: Dense UI text.

tokens.name: graphite-900
tokens.usage: Near-black neutral, used when violet ink would clash with photography.

tokens.name: graphite-950
tokens.usage: Darkest neutral.

tokens.name: logo-white
tokens.usage: The cool white of the logo mark. Page canvas on light sections, primary text on dark (15.3:1 on violet-950).

tokens.name: ice-100
tokens.usage: Cool ice tint between logo white and steel. Photo backdrop for equipment; ink sits on it at 12.8:1.

tokens.name: coral-500
tokens.usage: Errors on dark sections only.

tokens.name: coral-700
tokens.usage: Error text and invalid borders on light (6.1:1 on logo-white).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Section background. Light = the logo's white, dark = deep violet, brand = the logo's violet field.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, form panels and bands sitting on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted band: lifecycle, quotes, shop teaser.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Deep violet blocks inside a lighter section (CTA card, cover). Steps up in dark sections so it stays visible.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and primary text on canvas, surface and tint.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Paragraph text (9.6:1 light, 8.3:1 dark on surface, 5.4:1 brand).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions and eyebrows on canvas and surface (5.1:1 light, 5.7:1 dark on surface, 5:1 brand). Not on dark surface-tint.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px rules and card outlines. Decorative only.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and outline-button borders (3:1+ in every theme).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and links. In brand sections the button flips to logo white.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand; also brand-coloured text on surface-tint.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Soft brand fill: tags, chips, icon wells.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on a brand fill (5.9:1 light, 7.4:1 dark, 5.4:1 brand).

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: The heartbeat line, live dots and active step markers. Always a violet from the logo, never a new hue.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive states.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, 2px offset.

tokens.name: photo-ice
tokens.usage: Backdrop for equipment cut-outs. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: photo-lilac
tokens.usage: Second backdrop for equipment cut-outs. Same in every theme.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Footer wordmark and loader only. Mobile 72px. Fluid: clamp(72px, 10.5vw, 152px).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page hero headlines. Mobile 44px. Fluid: clamp(44px, 6.7vw, 96px).

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Providing a second life to your asset.
styles.usage: Home hero and big statements. Mobile 40px. Fluid: clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 64px). Glyphic's h1 is 500 weight, -0.04em, leading 1.0.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Three ways we work with your equipment.
styles.usage: Section titles and the scroll-fill statement. Mobile 28px. Regular weight, like Glyphic's h2.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Get a fair offer for surplus and retired equipment, and let us handle the rest.
styles.usage: Hero subheads and intro paragraphs. Max 560px wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every device we buy or service is checked by a biomedical engineer.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Payment is sent once equipment is collected.
styles.usage: Card descriptions, form help, footer links.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and nav labels, sentence case.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase mono label above every section title. Always paired with an index number.

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Equipment spec lines, model numbers, the loader counter. Uppercase.

styles.name: index
styles.usage: Small section and step numbers next to headings, set in the sans.

type.note: Sizes in px at the design width. Implemented as calc(N * var(--multiplier)) in globals.css. See BUILD-PLAYBOOK §3.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to title on mobile, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and form rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile gutter, card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, eyebrow to title.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Title block to content inside a section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop. Space is part of the look: be generous.

spacing.note: Implemented as --s-* multiplier variables. See BUILD-PLAYBOOK §3.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed media, hairline tables.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Images inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and media blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the scroll cue.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The sticky header once scrolled, and menus. Cards stay flat.

heal.note: The only easing on the site. No bounce, no spring overshoot.

layout.note: No page max-width container. Sections are full-bleed, inset by --s-margin-edge. See BUILD-PLAYBOOK §3.
